hints.content: As $x$ approaches positive infinity, what value does $g(x)$ seem to approach on each of the graphs?
Only on graphs A and B does $g(x)$ seem to approach $-2$ as $x$ approaches positive infinity.

question.content:
Consider graphs A, B, and C. The dashed lines represent asymptotes.

**Which graphs agree with this statement?**

$\displaystyle\lim_{x\to \infty}g(x)=-2$

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.clue: In this graph, $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to \infty}g(x)$ indeed seems to approach $-2$.
